name: Singapore Pharmaceutical & Biomedical Intelligence Extension
author: adamriofc
description: Production-grade Pharmaceutical, Biomedical, HSA Regulatory Affairs, PIC/S GMP & SS 585 GDP audits, Tropical Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) Cold Chain, ACE HTA Reimbursement, and HBRA / Health PDPA Clinical Trial compliance for Singapore enterprises.
statutoryFrameworks: Health Products Act 2007 (Cap. 122D) & Health Products (Therapeutic Products) Regulations 2016
Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (PDPA) & Advisory Guidelines for the Healthcare Sector
PIC/S Guide to Good Manufacturing Practice for Medicinal Products (PE 009-17)
Singapore Standard SS 585:2013 - Code of Practice for Good Distribution Practice for Medical Devices / SS GDP for Pharmaceuticals
HSA Guidance on Therapeutic Product Registration in Singapore (NDA / GDA Pathways)
Agency for Care Effectiveness (ACE) Health Technology Assessment (HTA) Framework (SDL & MAF Schemes)

skills.name: HSA Therapeutic Product Registration Navigator
skills.description: Navigate HSA therapeutic product registration pathways (Verification 60-day, Abridged 180-day, Full 270-day SLA), ACTD/ICH-CTD dossier evaluation, and compute statutory screening & evaluation fees under the Health Products Act.

skills.name: HSA PIC/S GMP & SS 585 GDP Good Practices Auditor
skills.description: Audit compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (PIC/S PE 009-17) and Good Distribution Practice (SS 585:2013) for HSA Manufacturer, Importer, and Wholesaler licensing, cleanroom HVAC qualification, and supply chain integrity.

skills.name: Tropical Cold Chain Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) Engine
skills.description: Audit pharmaceutical cold-chain temperature logs (2°C-8°C, CRT, frozen) against USP <1079> and Haynes (1971) Arrhenius kinetics, assessing ambient Singapore tropical heat excursions (30°C-32°C / 80% RH) and freezing degradation.

skills.name: HSA Adverse Drug Reaction (ADR) & Vigilance Auditor
skills.description: Audit adverse drug reactions against WHO-UMC causality categories and calculate HSA Vigilance and Compliance Branch (VCB) 15-calendar-day expedited fatal/life-threatening reporting deadlines.

skills.name: ACE HTA & Standard Drug List (SDL/MAF) Reimbursement Modeler
skills.description: Model hospital tender pricing, MOH Standard Drug List (SDL) and Medication Assistance Fund (MAF) co-payment subsidies, statutory GST 9% treatment, and distributor margins for public healthcare institutions (SingHealth, NHG, NUHS).

skills.name: Clinical Trial HBRA & Health PDPA Privacy Auditor
skills.description: Audit clinical trials and human biomedical research against Human Biomedical Research Act (HBRA 2015), HSA Clinical Trial Authorisation (CTA/CTN), and Singapore PDPA health data protection & cross-border transfer requirements.
